title: Upgrade to React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, and fumadocs v16
body:
## ✅ Upgrade Complete: React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, and fumadocs v16

### Upgraded Dependencies

**Root package.json:**
- React: 18.3.1 → **19.2.3** ⚡
- React-DOM: 18.3.1 → **19.2.3** ⚡
- Tailwind CSS: 3.x → **4.1.18** 🎨
- @types/react: 18.3.12 → **19.0.6**
- @types/react-dom: 18.3.1 → **19.0.3**

**apps/site/package.json:**
- fumadocs-core: 15.5.0 → **16.4.7** 📚
- fumadocs-mdx: 11.1.0 → **14.2.6** 📚
- fumadocs-ui: 15.5.0 → **16.4.7** 📚
- Next.js: 15.1.6 → **16.1.4** ⚡
- React: 18.3.1 → **19.2.3** ⚡
- React-DOM: 18.3.1 → **19.2.3** ⚡
- Tailwind CSS: 3.4.17 → **4.1.18** 🎨
- Added: **@tailwindcss/postcss** 4.1.18 (required for Tailwind v4)

### Breaking Changes Addressed

**1. Tailwind CSS v4:**
- Added `@tailwindcss/postcss` package for Next.js/Turbopack compatibility
- Updated `global.css` with proper fumadocs-ui CSS imports:
  ```css
  @import 'tailwindcss';
  @import 'fumadocs-ui/css/neutral.css';
  @import 'fumadocs-ui/css/preset.css';
  @source '../node_modules/fumadocs-ui/dist/**/*.js';
  ```
- Removed `tailwind.config.ts` (v4 uses CSS-first configuration)
- Updated `postcss.config.js` to use `@tailwindcss/postcss`

**2. fumadocs v16:**
- Provider import: `fumadocs-ui/provider` → `fumadocs-ui/provider/next`
- Source loader: Updated to use `toFumadocsSource()` from `fumadocs-mdx/runtime/server`
- Updated imports to use generated `.source/server` files

**3. React 19:**
- Updated pnpm overrides to ensure consistent React 19 usage across all packages
- Updated type definitions to React 19 compatible versions

### Configuration Files Changed

- ✅ `package.json` (root) - React 19, Tailwind v4
- ✅ `apps/site/package.json` - All dependencies updated
- ✅ `apps/site/app/global.css` - Tailwind v4 + fumadocs-ui imports
- ✅ `apps/site/postcss.config.js` - @tailwindcss/postcss plugin
- ✅ `apps/site/app/layout.tsx` - fumadocs provider import path
- ✅ `apps/site/lib/source.ts` - fumadocs v16 API
- ❌ `apps/site/tailwind.config.ts` - Removed (no longer needed in v4)

### Verification

✅ Site builds successfully with `next build`  
✅ Dev server runs without errors  
✅ All styles render correctly  
✅ Homepage displays properly  
✅ Documentation pages work as expected
